title: ETs teleport into CE-5 circle

tellings.quote: And we have had experiences where the ETs themselves have teleported right into our circle

plain: Extraterrestrials have teleported right into the middle of a group trying to contact them, according to Steven Greer, a doctor who leads CE-5 gatherings, short for "close encounters of the fifth kind", where people sit in a circle and try to call beings from elsewhere through meditation. Greer tells Michels that he and his groups "have had experiences where the ETs themselves have teleported right into our circle," which, if true, would mean contact can be invited.
